title: Vacuum Battery Depletion Anomaly
dataSources: Roborock sessions (`roborock:session`), Tidy schedules (`tidy:schedule`), cleaning checklists (`cleaning:checklist`), and vacuum runtime logs (`vacuum:runtime`).
app: Roborock vacuum session exports, Tidy scheduling logs, cleaning checklists, and runtime telemetry from robot vacuums ingested into Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=vacuum:runtime device_name=* battery_pct_end=* runtime_minutes=*
| eventstats avg(battery_pct_end) as avg_battery, stdev(battery_pct_end) as battery_stdev by device_name
| eval z_score=round((battery_pct_end-avg_battery)/nullif(battery_stdev,0),2)
| where z_score<=-2
| table _time device_name runtime_minutes battery_pct_end avg_battery z_score
description: Detects vacuum sessions where end-of-run battery fell two standard deviations below the device average.
value: Sudden battery drops often precede failing cells or brushes binding, causing incomplete cleans.
implementation: Capture `battery_pct_end` and `runtime_minutes` on every run and alert on low-battery outliers.
visualization: Table of anomalous sessions with battery z-score.
grandmaExplanation: It spots vacuum runs that ended with unusually low battery compared with normal.
